items.title: U.S. Clears Smallest Boeing 737 Max to Fly Following Years of Delays
items.summary: The certification is a big win for Southwest, which has been waiting for the aircraft for years as it looks to grow and replace parts of its aging fleet.

items.title: SAP Concur Adds New AI Tools for Approvals, Cards, and Travel Leakage
items.summary: Most of what SAP Concur announced adds AI to existing tools. The leakage-reporting tool built with Amex GBT is the exception — combining data the two platforms couldn't share before.

items.title: MakeMyTrip: Hotel Growth Offsets Decline in Air Travel; New IPO Details
items.summary: MakeMyTrip says the future of Indian travel growth lies beyond aviation, and is reorganizing both its business and capital structure around that.

items.title: Marriott Launches Owner Rebate Program Ahead of $125 Million Credit Card Fee Jump
items.summary: Marriott is paying franchisees back from its own pocket, but the credit card revenue owners want a share of is set to get up to $125 million larger a year.

items.title: Hotels Must Balance Comfort and Climate Goals As Guests Demand AC
items.summary: As extreme heat and guest expectations force European hotels toward air conditioning, EU efficiency standards — and their own climate commitments — mean they can’t solve for comfort alone.

items.title: Accor Concentrates on Makkah and Madinah as Gulf Tourism Cools
items.summary: Riyadh sets the pilgrim quota. Accor is building around it.

items.title: Younger Travelers Are Becoming Timeshare’s Most Vocal Advocates
items.summary: Vacation ownership, also known as timeshare, may be enjoying a reputational lift with younger buyers. New research suggests Millennials and Gen Z are bringing fresh momentum to the category by seeing ownership as a flexible, high-value way to keep travel central to their lives.

items.title: Hyatt Weighs ‘India-for-India’ Brand and Acquisitions for 5x Growth: Exclusive
items.summary: The world’s biggest hotel companies seem to have settled the “why India?” debate. The real competition now is over execution — acquisitions or partnerships, luxury or midscale, metros or smaller cities.
